text: Traditional medicine clinic for bones and colon cleansing. A wonderful experience, I recommend it. Pre-operative care, excellent service, appointments are taken in advance, and they speak English and Thai. Most of the visitors are from the Gulf region, especially Oman.
The place is clean, the service is good and polite, and the relaxing and hot compress massages are excellent.
A traditional Thai medicine clinic staffed by a specialist doctor. Wishing you health and well-being. The price is reasonable for the services offered as traditional medicine.
I don't recommend it; it's a lie and not good.
